title: User scope settings as canonical config
summary: Use ~/.pi/agent/settings.json for Cartographer model optimization config, including subagents.agentOverrides and cartographer.parentFallbackModels.

title: Role based model routing matrix
summary: Use fixed role-based defaults: parent/auditor/compass/redactor on gpt-5.5 medium, drafter on Spark, archivist on gpt-5.4-mini.

title: Workflow fallback wrapper
summary: Add Cartographer-owned fallback wrapper around retryable handoff/workflow model steps rather than modifying Pi core parent model runtime.

title: Cross provider approval gate
summary: Require explicit approval before fallback crosses from Codex subscription models to API-key providers, with CI pre-approval flag/config.

title: Reasoning escalation policy
summary: Keep medium as default; require receipts for high and human approval for xhigh. Never default xhigh.

title: Project settings as primary config
summary: Rejected because committed repo config could impose personal subscription/provider costs on users. Project settings may document examples only.

title: Agent frontmatter pins
summary: Rejected as primary mechanism because frontmatter pins are less flexible and harder for users to override globally.

title: Pi core parent fallback
summary: Rejected as out of Cartographer scope. Cartographer will wrap its own workflow/handoff calls instead.

title: No automatic fallback
summary: Rejected because it interrupts workflows even when safe same-provider fallback exists.

title: Settings Reader
summary: Reads user settings and extracts Cartographer/subagent fallback config with validation and defaults.

title: Failure Classifier
summary: Normalizes provider/model errors and extracts Codex rate-limit reset metadata.

title: Fallback Executor
summary: Runs bounded retry loop, selects fallback models, invokes approval, records receipts, and stops on exhaustion.

title: Approval Gate
summary: Handles interactive and non-interactive cross-provider approval with reset-time and cost warnings.

title: Receipt Writer
summary: Appends deterministic fallback and escalation receipts using existing handoff fallback where possible.

title: Validation Checks
summary: Tests/settings checks for xhigh defaults, fallback retry behavior, cross-provider approval, receipt schema, routing docs, and config bootstrap behavior.

title: Config Setup Workflow Skill
summary: Interactive workflow/skill invoked by the main agent when config is missing or partial; presents provider menu, recommends role models and main orchestrator model/thinking, warns on missing fallbacks, suggests free/subscription final fallbacks such as opencode/big-pickle when available, previews settings, and delegates writes to a deterministic JSON Schema + available-model validated writer.

title: Deterministic Settings Writer
summary: Script used by the setup skill to validate proposed settings with JSON Schema, validate provider/model IDs against available Pi models, reject invalid thinking/modality/fallback choices, preserve unrelated settings, and atomically write ~/.pi/agent/settings.json.

title: User settings schema drift
summary: cartographer.parentFallbackModels is new and requires explicit settings parsing/validation.

title: Surprise API cost
summary: Cross-provider fallback may incur token cost if not guarded.

title: Unsafe redactor fallback
summary: Cross-provider redactor fallback could weaken privacy review; require explicit approval and prefer within-Codex fallback.

title: Fallback loops
summary: Retrying across providers could loop indefinitely unless bounded by chain length.

title: Wrapper scope confusion
summary: Users may expect active parent model hot-swapping; design only retries Cartographer-controlled steps.
